title: Fix SonarCloud reliability findings left by the Platform 3.0 upgrade
body:
Fixes the `new_reliability_rating` gate failure that #274 left on `core-3.x`. All four findings sit on lines #274 only touched for the lang→lang3 switch; the issues themselves predate it.

- **TextTemplateRenderer.java:110 (S2259)**: reachable. An unknown design uuid gives `getDesign` an empty `ReportDesign`, so `getTemplate` returns null. It used to surface as `RenderingException("Unable to render results due to: java.lang.NullPointerException...")`. It now throws `RenderingException("No template found for report design with uuid: ...")`.
- **ParameterizableUtil.java:97 (S2259)**: reachable with a property the type does not have, or with a null type. The missing-property NPE was caught and rethrown as `IllegalArgumentException("Cannot retrieve Mapped type from: X.prop")`; a null type escaped as an NPE from that message. The new `getMappedField` throws that same exception up front, and a null type is reported as `null.prop`.
- **MappedPropertyPortletController.java:136 (S2259)**: reachable when `property` is empty, because `mappedType` stays null and `getSimpleName()` is evaluated even when a `typeLabel` was supplied. `nvlStr` now gets null, so the fallback is `""`.
- **SqlRunner.java:41 (S8786)**: `DELIMITER_PATTERN` now uses possessive quantifiers (`\s*+`, `(\S++)`). Giving characters back never changes whether a line matches or what `group(2)` captures, so it accepts the same lines. `SqlRunnerTest` checks `getNewDelimiter` against the previous pattern, kept in the test with `NOSONAR`, over a list of representative SQL lines and 200,000 randomly assembled ones. The random check catches deliberately wrong variants: dropping `=?` gave 2,682 mismatches and `\s++` gave 25,482.

New tests: `ParameterizableUtilTest`, a missing-template case in `TextTemplateRendererTest`, and three `SqlRunnerTest` cases. The NPE tests failed before the fix. There is no omod test harness, so the portlet change has no test.

Build (Java 21, `mvn -fae clean install`): api-tests `Tests run: 837, Failures: 0, Errors: 15, Skipped: 14`, OMOD SUCCESS. Plain `core-3.x` gives `Tests run: 830, Failures: 0, Errors: 15, Skipped: 14`. The 15 errors are the same pre-existing `ReportServiceAuthorizationTest` failures (`AuthorizationDeniedException`), and `core-3.x`'s own CI run 38076382487 fails on them too. They are why this PR's Maven checks are red.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates reporting so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). It depends on openmrs/openmrs-module-htmlwidgets#18 and openmrs/openmrs-module-serialization.xstream#22. Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Build:
  - Module version is now 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, on core 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (with `openmrs-bom` imported), htmlwidgets 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, serialization.xstream 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT, calculation 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT and legacyui 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
  - Builds with Java 21 and `-parameters`.
  - Libraries core already ships are `provided` or excluded from bundling: joda-time, encoder, jackson, snakeyaml, jakarta.mail, commons-codec/logging/lang3/text.
  - `jackson-dataformat-yaml` is aligned with core's Jackson.
  - **handlebars 1.1.2 becomes 4.5.5.** 1.1.2 drags in antlr4-runtime 4.1, which clashes with Hibernate 7's antlr 4.13 and broke the SessionFactory. 4.5.5 is also past GHSA-r4gv-qr8j-p3pg, fixed in 4.5.2. `TemplateFactory` keeps 1.x's HTML escaping (`EscapingStrategy.HBS3`), because 4.x also escapes `=`, which changed report filenames and labels.
  - openmrs-web and htmlwidgets are now omod-only dependencies.
  - CI uses JDK 21.
- `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
- javax.servlet/mail/activation become jakarta, commons-lang becomes lang3, codehaus Jackson becomes fasterxml, and Velocity 2 keeps 1.7-compatible settings.
- `PatientIdSet` calls `setMemberships` directly. The reflective call silently failed against 3.0's new signature and broke cohort subtraction.
- Spring context:
  - Core 3.0 removed `serializationServiceTarget` and the `supportedTypes` property used by `parent="serializedObjectDAO"`.
  - The reporting serializer and the 11 serialized definition types are now registered through `MethodInvokingBean`s.
  - The service `TransactionProxyFactoryBean`s are unchanged.
- DAOs:
  - `HibernateReportDAO` moves from Criteria to HQL, with saves via `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate`.
  - `HibernateCohortQueryDAO` binds dates with their types, and reads named parameters from the query's parameter metadata (Hibernate 7's query string has them replaced by `?`).
  - `HibernateDataSetQueryDAO` uses the mapping metamodel.
  - `HqlQueryBuilder` reads columns from the parsed query and drops duplicate auto-generated aliases, which Hibernate 7 rejects.
  - `BirthAndDeathCohortDefinitionEvaluator` selects `p.patientId`.
- Mappings:
  - `identity` id generators.
  - Enums use core's `StringEnumType`.
  - `PropertiesType` and `ReportDefinitionType` use Hibernate 7 UserType signatures.
  - `ReportRequest`'s two-column types become Hibernate 7 `CompositeUserType`s mapped as `<component>`s, with the same columns, so no liquibase change.
- Web:
  - The JSTL fmt URI is now `jakarta.tags.fmt`.
  - Three suffix-less `@RequestMapping`s also map their `.form` URL.
  - `includeScripts.jsp` no longer uses `<spring:theme>`, which Spring 7 removed, matching legacyui 3.0.
- Tests:
  - Migrated to JUnit 5.
  - The test dataset is updated for the 3.0 schema: uuids added, and `concept_name_tag_map` rows removed because the table has no PK in the test schema.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes: 830 tests, 0 failures (14 already-ignored tests skipped), on JDK 21 and 25.
- On openmrs-core master **with openmrs/openmrs-core#6633** (needed so core's `StringEnumType` can load module enums) and #6631 (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8), in the full set of 26 upgraded O3 modules:
  - All modules start, and logging in through the UI works.
  - `/module/reporting/dashboard/index.form`, the cohort and data set definition managers, and `runReport.list` render.
  - An ad hoc patient data set evaluated through reportingrest (the built-in "males" cohort plus a gender column) returns the expected rows.

title: (docs) Replace the dead Travis badge with the GitHub Actions one
body:
The README badge still points at travis-ci.org, which shut down and now redirects to a 404, so the badge renders blank. This module builds on GitHub Actions via build.yml, so this points the badge and its link there.

Heads up that the badge will show red right now: the latest build.yml run on master failed on 2026-09-03 on the OWASP dependency check job, not the Maven build.

title: REPORT-924: Require privileges for Reporting service methods
body:
This adds privilege annotations to all `*Service` classes in this module. I tried to decide privileges to assign privileges  using the following rules:

* Where possible to pull a privilege from existing JSP pages, prefer that
* All methods needed to run reports should be protected by Run Reports
* All methods needed to view reports should be protected by View Reports
* All methods needed to change reports should be protected by Manage Reports
* If a more specific privilege exists (e.g., Manage Report Definitions vs Manage Reports), prefer that where applicable

This also adds two tests to characterize this behaviour:

1. `ServicePrivilegeConventionsTest` attempts to enforce standard privilege conventions across all services, e.g., "every service method should require a privilege", "read privileges should never guard a write method", etc.
2. `ReportServiceAuthorizationTest` which checks that the privileges on the `ReportService` are enforced at runtime.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests
